reviews.comment: He's a great guy that is very accessible outside class and responds to emails within hours. He's also very forgiving with partial credit on exams. My only gripe about this class is that he tends to struggle explaining certain topics, especially toward the end of the course. However, keep in mind he is young and has plenty of time to improve.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Definitely a fun guy with good intentions. I found his lectures to be confusing because he goes quick and I had a hard time understanding his explanations. Weekly quizzes were difficult and often had to request regrade. iClicker quiz almost every class. BUT, if you are good at math and take it seriously, it won't be too hard. Josiah is nice overall

The people who say that the practice exams are nothing like the actual exams, they dont understand math at all. he is an amazing prof who is willing to help you, PERSONALLY, the course is not hard, as long as you study and take it seriously youll be fine. He also offers extra credit, and wants his students to learn. idk what everyone is yappin abt

Nice guy with good intentions, however I have As in everything but struggled to get a B in his class. He expects us to understand aspects of the material we don't know as well as he would. His quizzes are a few questions and sometimes pretty hard, getting one wrong can result in a low grade and tank the over class grade. Be prepared to need tutors.

There are about 8 assignments a week that are pretty difficult and his tests are nothing like the practice test given by the math department. He also gets some of the notes wrong leaving you to wonder if you're actually doing the work right.

Professor Owens is very nice and teaches everything during lectures. Tests are split into two days, one day being multiple choice and the other being free response. Some grades are dropped and if you keep up with the lectures and homework, this class will be fairly easy.

He explains concepts clearly in lectures, but it does not translate to tests and quizzes very well, combining unfamiliar concepts that even tutors find confusing. Mistakes in lectures add to the challenge, and there's little flexibility or understanding. Be ready for tough, self-directed learning and to spend a lot of extra hours self-teaching.

Professor Owens does a really good job at making sure you understand the section being taught in lecture. IClicker is done almost everyday and there is a quiz every friday (sometimes take home or open note). Overall he was a really good professor and I would take him again.

This course is difficult, but this professor provides clear instructions that are usually easy to follow. He provides extra credit opportunities after each exam and drops grades at the end of the semester as well. Although attendance isn't taken you definitely need to come to class to pass.

Best math 142 professor, lectures are simple and straightforward. Cares about the students and is willing to help. Exams are 3 plus a final, he gives 5 points of extra credit in the exams. not a tough grader and you genuinely learn with him. Please do take him.
